# Code of conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be kind, assume good intent, and keep feedback about the work, not the person. Harassment, insults and personal attacks aren't welcome in issues, discussions or pull requests.

To report a problem, message [@Adi-UA](https://github.com/Adi-UA) on GitHub. Reports stay private, and the maintainer may hide comments, lock threads or block users who break these rules.
